title: Standing Orders Protocol for Diabetes Screening Tests
implementation_guidance: Establish standing orders for nurse care managers to implement clinical practice guidelines without requiring physician approval for each instance, including: HbA1C testing (quarterly for uncontrolled patients), LDL testing (annually or more frequently if elevated), nephropathy screening (annual urine microalbumin), yearly ophthalmologic exam referrals, and performance of comprehensive foot exams.
expected_outcomes: Increased adherence to recommended screening tests, earlier detection of diabetes complications, reduced clinical inertia, improved efficiency of care delivery, and better clinical outcomes through systematic implementation of evidence-based guidelines.
target_population: Medicaid-enrolled individuals with type 2 diabetes, particularly those at high risk for complications or with limited access to specialty care.
citation: Stuckey HL, Dellasega C, Graber NJ, Mauger DT, Lendel I, Gabbay RA. Diabetes Nurse Case Management and Motivational Interviewing for Change (DYNAMIC): Study Design and Baseline Characteristics in the Chronic Care Model for Type 2 Diabetes. Contemp Clin Trials. 2009;30(4):366-374. doi:10.1016/j.cct.2009.03.002.
